text:
Anuj: Heads-up — after last night's KMS rewrap we saw per-route scope enforcement regress for embeddings routes. Calls with scope ['embeddings.create'] are getting allowed as chat.gen or failing. Anyone else?
Claire: saw a spike in 500s from the authz service around 03:12 UTC, filing alert. pd: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/3752
Kevin: logs? sample token decoded: `{'sub':'svc:widget','scopes':['embeddings.create'],'key_tag':'v2-2026-03-19'}` but authz decision shows `allowed_scopes:['chat.gen']`
Anuj: exact log: 
```
authz=decide route=/v1/embeddings svc=authz pid=1123 token_scopes=[embeddings.create] resolved_allowlist=[chat.gen] decision=DENY
```
Jia: likely cause = scope-tag lost on rewrap or legacy tag precedence. KMS rotated tag -> authz cache uses key_tag->scope-map. If metadata didn't propagate, mapping falls back to old default allowlist.
Claire: SecBot shows rotation event: `SecBot: keys/v2-2026-03-19 rewrap success (id=lkj345)` — maybe metadata didn't replicate to policy DB (or the sync job failed).
Kevin: quick mitigation — invalidate authz cache for all tokens with key_tag matching v2-2026-03-19. Running probe script now: `./scripts/invalidate-authz-cache --tag v2-2026-03-19 --dry-run`
Anuj: ok can we also add a temporary fallback in route matcher to prefer explicit token-scopes over key_tag mapping until we confirm fix? That keeps embeddings routes from accidentally matching chat allowlist.
Jia: agree; I'll open PR to add explicit per-token scope verification + audit logging (and a short-lived feature flag). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1234
Claire: created incident ticket SE-2026-43, classification:sev2, ETA 2 hours for full rollback if needed. Notifying customers affected by embeddings-only scope.
SecBot: automated note: audit-log flushed for all authz invalidations at 03:28 UTC (job id=authz-inv-2026-03-19-03-28).
Kevin: probe results — invalidated cache and revalidated 2.3k tokens; 99.8% now correctly map. Two consumer keys still failing — owners pinged (owner: @kevin, owner: @s-svc-team).
Anuj: nice. keep me posted. :thumbsup:
